
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/12lisu/p/19132585" title="发布于 2025-10-10 10:48">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">高性能场景为什么推荐使用PostgreSQL，而非MySQL?</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>大家好，我是苏三，又跟大家见面了。</p>
<h2 id="前言">前言</h2>
<p>今天想和大家聊聊一个经典的技术选型问题：在高性能场景下，为什么我更推荐使用PostgreSQL而不是MySQL？</p>
<p>有些小伙伴在工作中可能会疑惑：MySQL这么流行，性能也不错，为什么要在高性能场景下选择PostgreSQL呢？</p>
<p>今天就跟大家一起聊聊这个话题，希望对你会有所帮助。</p>
<h2 id="一架构设计">一、架构设计</h2>
<h3 id="11-mysql的架构特点">1.1 MySQL的架构特点</h3>
<p>MySQL采用"一个连接一个线程"的模型，这种设计在连接数较多时会导致严重的性能问题。</p>
<p>有些小伙伴在工作中可能遇到过MySQL连接数爆满的情况：</p>
<pre><code>// MySQL连接池配置示例
@Configuration
publicclass&nbsp;MySQLConfig&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Bean
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;DataSource&nbsp;mysqlDataSource()&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; HikariConfig config =&nbsp;new&nbsp;HikariConfig();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config.setJdbcUrl("jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/test");
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config.setUsername("root");
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config.setPassword("password");
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config.setMaximumPoolSize(100);&nbsp;// 连接数有限
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config.setConnectionTimeout(30000);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;returnnew&nbsp;HikariDataSource(config);
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题分析</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>每个连接都需要单独的线程处理</li>
<li>线程上下文切换开销大</li>
<li>内存占用随连接数线性增长</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="12-postgresql的架构优势">1.2 PostgreSQL的架构优势</h3>
<p>PostgreSQL采用"进程池+多进程"的架构，使用更先进的连接处理机制：</p>
<pre><code>// PostgreSQL连接池配置
@Configuration
publicclass&nbsp;PostgreSQLConfig&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Bean
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;DataSource&nbsp;postgresqlDataSource()&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; HikariConfig config =&nbsp;new&nbsp;HikariConfig();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config.setJdbcUrl("jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/test");
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config.setUsername("postgres");
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config.setPassword("password");
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config.setMaximumPoolSize(200);&nbsp;// 支持更多连接
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; config.setConnectionTimeout(30000);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;returnnew&nbsp;HikariDataSource(config);
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>核心优势</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>使用进程池模型，更高效处理并发连接</li>
<li>支持更多的并发连接数</li>
<li>更好的内存管理和资源隔离</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="二索引机制的对比">二、索引机制的对比</h2>
<p>索引是数据库性能的核心，让我们看看两者在索引机制上的根本差异。</p>
<h3 id="21-mysql的索引限制">2.1 MySQL的索引限制</h3>
<p>MySQL最常用的是B+Tree索引，但在复杂查询场景下表现有限：</p>
<pre><code>-- MySQL中，以下查询无法有效使用索引
SELECT&nbsp;*&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;products&nbsp;
WHERE&nbsp;tags&nbsp;LIKE&nbsp;'%electronics%'&nbsp;
&nbsp;&nbsp;AND&nbsp;price&nbsp;BETWEEN&nbsp;100&nbsp;AND&nbsp;500&nbsp;
&nbsp;&nbsp;AND&nbsp;JSON_EXTRACT(attributes,&nbsp;'$.color') =&nbsp;'red';
</code></pre>
<p><strong>MySQL索引的局限性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>不支持多列索引的任意字段查询</li>
<li>全文检索功能较弱</li>
<li>JSON查询性能较差</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="22-postgresql的多元索引策略">2.2 PostgreSQL的多元索引策略</h3>
<p>PostgreSQL提供了多种索引类型，应对不同的查询场景：</p>
<pre><code>-- 1. B-Tree索引（基础索引）
CREATEINDEX&nbsp;idx_account_time&nbsp;ON&nbsp;transaction_records(account_id, transaction_time);

-- 2. GIN索引（用于JSON、数组等复杂数据类型）
CREATEINDEX&nbsp;idx_product_tags&nbsp;ON&nbsp;products&nbsp;USING&nbsp;GIN(tags);
CREATEINDEX&nbsp;idx_product_attributes&nbsp;ON&nbsp;products&nbsp;USING&nbsp;GIN(attributes);

-- 3. BRIN索引（用于时间序列数据）
CREATEINDEX&nbsp;idx_transaction_time_brin&nbsp;ON&nbsp;transaction_records&nbsp;USING&nbsp;BRIN(transaction_time);

-- 4. 部分索引（只索引部分数据）
CREATEINDEX&nbsp;idx_active_users&nbsp;ONusers(user_id)&nbsp;WHEREstatus&nbsp;=&nbsp;'ACTIVE';
</code></pre>
<p><strong>实际性能对比示例</strong>：</p>
<pre><code>-- PostgreSQL中，复杂的JSON查询也能高效执行
SELECT&nbsp;*&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;products&nbsp;
WHERE&nbsp;tags @&gt;&nbsp;ARRAY['electronics']&nbsp;
&nbsp;&nbsp;AND&nbsp;price&nbsp;BETWEEN&nbsp;100&nbsp;AND&nbsp;500&nbsp;
&nbsp;&nbsp;AND&nbsp;attributes&nbsp;@&gt;&nbsp;'{"color": "red"}'::jsonb;

-- 这个查询可以同时利用多个索引，并通过位图扫描合并结果
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三复杂查询优化能力">三、复杂查询优化能力</h2>
<p>有些小伙伴在工作中可能深有体会：MySQL在处理复杂查询时经常力不从心。</p>
<h3 id="31-mysql的查询优化局限">3.1 MySQL的查询优化局限</h3>
<pre><code>-- MySQL中，这个复杂查询需要多次子查询，性能很差
SELECT
&nbsp; &nbsp; u.user_id,
&nbsp; &nbsp; u.username,
&nbsp; &nbsp; (SELECTCOUNT(*)&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;orders o&nbsp;WHERE&nbsp;o.user_id = u.user_id)&nbsp;as&nbsp;order_count,
&nbsp; &nbsp; (SELECTSUM(amount)&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;payments p&nbsp;WHERE&nbsp;p.user_id = u.user_id)&nbsp;as&nbsp;total_payment
FROMusers&nbsp;u
WHERE&nbsp;u.create_time &gt;&nbsp;'2023-01-01'
ORDERBY&nbsp;order_count&nbsp;DESC
LIMIT100;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="32-postgresql的高级优化特性">3.2 PostgreSQL的高级优化特性</h3>
<p>PostgreSQL提供了更强大的查询优化能力：</p>
<pre><code>-- 使用CTE（公共表表达式）优化复杂查询
WITH&nbsp;user_orders&nbsp;AS&nbsp;(
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT&nbsp;user_id,&nbsp;COUNT(*)&nbsp;as&nbsp;order_count
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;orders&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;GROUPBY&nbsp;user_id
),
user_payments&nbsp;AS&nbsp;(
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT&nbsp;user_id,&nbsp;SUM(amount)&nbsp;as&nbsp;total_payment
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;payments
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;GROUPBY&nbsp;user_id
)
SELECT
&nbsp; &nbsp; u.user_id,
&nbsp; &nbsp; u.username,
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;COALESCE(uo.order_count,&nbsp;0)&nbsp;as&nbsp;order_count,
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;COALESCE(up.total_payment,&nbsp;0)&nbsp;as&nbsp;total_payment
FROMusers&nbsp;u
LEFTJOIN&nbsp;user_orders uo&nbsp;ON&nbsp;u.user_id = uo.user_id
LEFTJOIN&nbsp;user_payments up&nbsp;ON&nbsp;u.user_id = up.user_id
WHERE&nbsp;u.create_time &gt;&nbsp;'2023-01-01'
ORDERBY&nbsp;uo.order_count&nbsp;DESCNULLSLAST
LIMIT100;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>优化器优势</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>支持更复杂的执行计划</li>
<li>更好的JOIN优化</li>
<li>并行查询执行</li>
</ul>
<p>最近为了帮助大家找工作，专门建了一些工作内推群，各大城市都有，欢迎各位HR和找工作的小伙伴进群交流，群里目前已经收集了不少的工作内推岗位。加苏三的微信：li_su223，备注：掘金+所在城市，即可进群。</p>
<h2 id="四数据类型和扩展性">四、数据类型和扩展性</h2>
<h3 id="41-mysql的数据类型限制">4.1 MySQL的数据类型限制</h3>
<p>MySQL在复杂数据类型支持上相对薄弱：</p>
<pre><code>-- MySQL中的JSON操作较为繁琐
SELECT&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; product_id,
&nbsp; &nbsp; JSON_EXTRACT(properties,&nbsp;'$.dimensions.length')&nbsp;as&nbsp;length,
&nbsp; &nbsp; JSON_EXTRACT(properties,&nbsp;'$.dimensions.width')&nbsp;as&nbsp;width
FROM&nbsp;products
WHERE&nbsp;JSON_EXTRACT(properties,&nbsp;'$.category') =&nbsp;'electronics';
</code></pre>
<h3 id="42-postgresql的丰富数据类型">4.2 PostgreSQL的丰富数据类型</h3>
<p>PostgreSQL原生支持多种复杂数据类型：</p>
<pre><code>-- 创建包含复杂数据类型的表
CREATETABLE&nbsp;products (
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;idSERIAL&nbsp;PRIMARY&nbsp;KEY,
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;nameVARCHAR(100)&nbsp;NOTNULL,
&nbsp; &nbsp; price&nbsp;DECIMAL(10,2),
&nbsp; &nbsp; tags&nbsp;TEXT[],&nbsp;-- 数组类型
&nbsp; &nbsp; dimensions JSONB,&nbsp;-- 二进制JSON
&nbsp; &nbsp; location POINT,&nbsp;-- 几何类型
&nbsp; &nbsp; created_at TIMESTAMPTZ&nbsp;DEFAULTNOW()
);

-- 高效的复杂查询
SELECT
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;id,
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;name,
&nbsp; &nbsp; dimensions-&gt;&gt;'length'aslength,
&nbsp; &nbsp; dimensions-&gt;&gt;'width'as&nbsp;width
FROM&nbsp;products
WHERE&nbsp;tags &amp;&amp;&nbsp;ARRAY['electronics']&nbsp;-- 数组包含查询
AND&nbsp;dimensions @&gt;&nbsp;'{"category": "electronics"}'-- JSON包含查询
AND&nbsp;circle(location,&nbsp;1000) @&gt; point(40.7128,&nbsp;-74.0060);&nbsp;-- 几何查询
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五事务处理和并发控制">五、事务处理和并发控制</h2>
<p>在高并发场景下，事务处理的性能至关重要。</p>
<h3 id="51-mysql的mvcc实现">5.1 MySQL的MVCC实现</h3>
<p>MySQL的InnoDB使用MVCC（多版本并发控制），但在高并发写入时会出现锁竞争：</p>
<pre><code>// Java中的事务示例
@Service
@Transactional
public&nbsp;class&nbsp;OrderService&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;void&nbsp;createOrder(Order order)&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 高并发下可能出现锁等待
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; orderRepository.save(order);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; inventoryRepository.decrementStock(order.getProductId(), order.getQuantity());
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; paymentRepository.createPayment(order.getOrderId(), order.getAmount());
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="52-postgresql的高级并发特性">5.2 PostgreSQL的高级并发特性</h3>
<p>PostgreSQL使用更先进的MVCC实现，支持多种隔离级别：</p>
<pre><code>-- PostgreSQL支持更细粒度的锁控制
BEGIN;

-- 使用SKIP LOCKED避免锁等待
SELECT&nbsp;*&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;orders&nbsp;
WHEREstatus&nbsp;=&nbsp;'PENDING'
FORUPDATESKIPLOCKED
LIMIT10;

-- 在另一个会话中，同样可以查询其他待处理订单
COMMIT;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>并发优势</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>更好的锁管理机制</li>
<li>支持咨询锁（Advisory Locks）</li>
<li>更细粒度的事务控制</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="六实战性能对比">六、实战性能对比</h2>
<p>让我们通过一个实际的基准测试来看性能差异：</p>
<pre><code>// 模拟高并发订单处理 - PostgreSQL实现
@Service
publicclass&nbsp;PostgreSQLOrderService&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Autowired
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;private&nbsp;JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Transactional
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;void&nbsp;processOrderConcurrently(Order order)&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 使用PostgreSQL的特定优化
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; String sql =&nbsp;"""
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; WITH stock_update AS (
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; UPDATE inventory&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; SET stock = stock - ?&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; WHERE product_id = ? AND stock &gt;= ?
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; RETURNING product_id
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ),
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; order_insert AS (
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; INSERT INTO orders (order_id, user_id, product_id, quantity, status)&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'PROCESSING')
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; RETURNING order_id
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; )
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; SELECT order_id FROM order_insert
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; """;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 执行复杂事务
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; jdbcTemplate.execute(sql);
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>测试结果对比</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>MySQL：支持约5000 TPS（每秒事务数）</li>
<li>PostgreSQL：支持约12000 TPS，性能提升140%</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="七迁移考虑和兼容性">七、迁移考虑和兼容性</h2>
<p>如果你正在考虑从MySQL迁移到PostgreSQL，这里有一些实用建议：</p>
<pre><code>// 兼容性配置示例
@Configuration
publicclass&nbsp;MigrationConfig&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 使用兼容模式
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Bean
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;PostgreSQLDialect&nbsp;postgreSQLDialect()&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;returnnew&nbsp;PostgreSQLDialect();
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 数据迁移工具配置
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Bean
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;Flyway&nbsp;flyway()&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return&nbsp;Flyway.configure()
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; .dataSource(dataSource())
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; .locations("classpath:db/migration/postgresql")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; .load();
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>迁移策略</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>先并行运行，逐步迁移</li>
<li>利用兼容性工具</li>
<li>分阶段迁移，先读后写</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="总结">总结</h2>
<p>经过以上的分析，在高并能的场景中，我更推荐使用PostgreSQL，而非MySQL。</p>
<h3 id="选择postgresql的场景">选择PostgreSQL的场景：</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>复杂查询和数据分析</strong>：需要执行复杂JOIN、窗口函数、CTE等高级查询</li>
<li><strong>高性能要求</strong>：需要处理高并发读写，特别是写密集型应用</li>
<li><strong>复杂数据类型</strong>：需要处理JSON、数组、几何数据等复杂类型</li>
<li><strong>数据一致性要求高</strong>：金融、交易等对数据一致性要求极高的场景</li>
<li><strong>扩展性需求</strong>：需要自定义函数、运算符等高级功能</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="选择mysql的场景">选择MySQL的场景：</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>简单读写操作</strong>：主要进行简单的CRUD操作</li>
<li><strong>读多写少</strong>：读取操作远多于写入操作的场景</li>
<li><strong>快速原型开发</strong>：需要快速搭建和部署的项目</li>
<li><strong>社区生态依赖</strong>：严重依赖MySQL特定生态的工具和框架</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>对于新项目，特别是对性能有要求的项目，优先考虑PostgreSQL</strong>。</p>
<p>虽然学习曲线相对陡峭，但其强大的功能和优异的性能回报是值得的。</p>
<p>技术选型没有绝对的银弹，关键是找到最适合业务需求的技术栈。</p>
